cards.title: Use case & problem
cards.subtitle: Invoice Decision Intelligence & Autonomous Approval

description.plain:
Use case & problem

Industry / user persona — Manufacturing, Utilities & Enterprise Shared Services | AP Clerks, Procurement Heads, Controllers, Plant Requisitioners

Problem (3 bullets) — • Multi-channel intake fragmentation across paper scans, vendor emails, and statutory IRN e-invoices.
• 70%+ AP clerk time wasted manually cross-referencing PO line items, goods receipts, and quality inspection lots.
• Financial leakage from price creep, duplicate submissions, and forfeited GST Input Tax Credits under strict 48-hour SLAs.

cards.title: Prerequisites & next step
cards.subtitle: Invoice Decision Intelligence & Autonomous Approval

description.plain:
Prerequisites & next step

BTP services + entitlements — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime (1 GB compute), SAP BTP Destination Service (standard), Authorization & Trust Management (XSUAA), SAP Integration Suite (optional for iFlows), SAP AI Core (Phase 2 DOX).

S/4HANA config / authorizations — S/4HANA 2020+ (Cloud or On-Premise); Communication Arrangement SAP_COM_0008 (Business Partner), SAP_COM_0053 (Purchase Order), SAP_COM_0108 (Material Doc), SAP_COM_0057 (Supplier Invoice); Technical user with LIV authorization.
